Tour de Latte

Colorado Springs, CO · Old North End · Social · Road

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Tour de Latte is a social and road group ride in Colorado Springs, CO. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from E Fontanero St & N Weber St. About 10–25 miles, casual, 8–10 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8–10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tour de Latte group ride

A slow Saturday social ride that stops at a different independent coffee shop each week. Corners are posted and there is a sweep. Distance grows through the season, from about 10 miles in May to 20–25 later on.
